tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas sgrib pa sbyong ba bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgo nas tshe las 'das pa'i sgrib pa sbyong bar 'dod pas/ thog mar gnas gang yang rung bar sa blang ba nas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i bar dbang gi cho ga bzhin du bya/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ rta mgrin gyi las kyi bum pa gnyis kyang sta gon du bya/ mchod pa dang gtor ma ci ltar 'byor ba bzhin du bshams/ de ltar bca' gzhi yongs su rdzogs nas/ cho ga'i rim pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gsum las/ dang po ni tshe las 'das pa yis gtso byas pa'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed la yan lag bdun pa bya'o// gnyis pa bdag bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bha wa shud dho sarba dharmā sa bha ba shud dho haṃ gis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam/ de'i ngang nas pad ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i steng du/ rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hri dmar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa las bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar ba la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'phreng ba/ g.yon pad ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can no// de'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ snying khar hūm̐ gis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ de nas thugs khar pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba la hrīḥ snying po dang bcas pa bltas la/ 'od zer gyis de lta bu bde ba can nas spyan drangs la/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hos dbyer med du gzhug /badz+ra puṣ+pe a hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bdag bskyed mchod/ de nas 'byung po la gtor ma dbul la snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bgegs bskrad de/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes rdo rje'i gur khang yang bsam mo// gsum pa bum pa bskyed pa ni/

rnam rgyal bum pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa ltar yin la/ spyan 'dren dang mchod bstod bsdus pa cig bya'o// las bum du hrīḥlas byung ba'i rta mgrin zhal cig phyag gnyis pa bskyed la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod la/ thugs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// zhes pa'i bstod pas bstod de/ de dag ni sngon du 'gro ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po swa bha bas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha bskyed pa'am yang na pad ma cod pan gyi rgyud la sogs pa nas byung ba ltar byed na'ang so so'i cho gas bskyed de/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs yan chad rdzogs nas/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// ces pa'i spyan 'dren bya'o// phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gdan 'bul ba dang*/ phyi dang nang gi la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams phul la/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// zhes pa'i bstod pas bstod la/ gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi gtor ma'ang btang ngo*// de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i cho ga'i bya ba rdzogs nas/ gnyis pa tshe las 'das pa'i don bya ba dngos la drug las/ dang po bskyed cing dgug pa ni/ ming byang la sogs pa las bum gyi chu dang swa bha bas bsangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las ming gi yi ge dang po ṇi las tshe 'das ci 'dra ba bskyed la/ bdag gi thugs kha nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros pas tshe las 'das pa rnam par shes pa gang na gnas kyang bkug par bsams te/ ngag tu/ dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dang bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs rje'i byin brlabs kyi bden pas/ tshe 'das che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa rigs drug skye gnas bzhi gar gnas kyang*/ skad cig tsam gyis 'dir mchis par gyur cig

ces lan gsum brjod la/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hos rten la gzhug go /gnyis pa gshed dang dbral ba ni/ bgegs kyi gtor ma ting lo dang chang bur bcas pa la/ oṃ sarba big nan na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi sha mu ke bh+ya sarba tad khang ud ga te s+pha ra na hi maṃ ga ga na kham̐ gh+ri rna e taṃ ba ling tam̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod nas rten la bskor zhing*/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i gson gyi dus su tshe la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi tshe sdig pa sbyong la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'di khyer la/ dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su ma gnas par song shig /ces brjod la rta mgrin gyi ting nge 'dzin dang sngags brjod de gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis brab/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad cing sum bha ni yang bzlas so// gsum pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib lte ba nas kaṃ gi rnam pa sna sgo'i lam du phyung ste sdig pa rwa can du gyur nas til la thim par bsams nas mer bsreg cing chur dor la/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ de ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur cig shin ting ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod do// bzhi pa khrus bya ba ni/ thog mar lha la khrus gsol ba ni me long la lha'i gzugs 'char bar byas la/ las kyi bum pas khrus byas te/ ci ltar ltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ oṃ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma yā shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing khrus byas pa'i chu slar bum par blug go /de nas ming byang ngam/ rus bu la sogs me long la gzugs 'char par byas la bkru zhing*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin brlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub gsol bar mdzad// 'di ni spyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// sbyin pa dri yis legs bsgos chu/

khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// de bzhin du gzhan rnams 'gre'o// 'di ni tshul khrims= khrims 'chal dri= tshul khrims dri yis= khrus legs mdzad= 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin= khong kho'i dri ma sbyong = bzod pa dri yis= khrus legs mdzad= 'di ni brtson 'grus= le lo'i dri ma sbyong = brtson 'grus dri yis= khrus legs mdzad= 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin= rnam g.yeng dri ma= bsam gtan dri yis legs= khrus legs mdzad la= 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin= gti mug dri ma= shes rab dri yis= khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// rgyal chen yon tan drug ldan zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis// yon tan thams cad ldan pa yi// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes bya ba'i tshig bzhi pa re re'i bar du/ oṃ ā hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tshes las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shud dhe shud dhe bhi shud dhe swā hā/ zhes bya ba re re dang spel bar bya'o// lnga pa dug sbyang ba ni/ 'dod chags zhes sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// 'gre'o// 'dod chags= 'di dag= sangs rgyas= dam chos= dam chos bden= 'dod chags zhe sdang = 'di dag= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun= sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// chu me rlung la sogs kyis 'don pa kha bsgyur la brjod do// rjes la/ dus las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dug gsum/

dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs kyis 'byung ba'i bag la zha bar gyur cig 'byung ba'i nang du thim par gyur cig ces brjod do// de'i rjes su bde legs kyi tshig 'di brjod par bya'o// sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyis bsams pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de deng 'dir grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shog /khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /dus las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig drug pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba ni gsum las/ dang po sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya ba ni/ tshe 'das kyi nye ba yod na lad mo byed du gzhug med na yid kyis de nyid kyis lad mo byed par bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing*/ ngag tu/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// tha ma da lta thug gi bar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas ni// sdig pa dpag med bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yid rang dang*// khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// slad chad bdag ni mi bgyid do// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa rang rgyal nyan thos kyi// yan lag rnams kyang bzung bar bgyi// 'gro rnams kun gyi dge ba la// bdag ni rjes su yid rang ngo*// bde gshegs chos sku la bzhugs te// 'gro ba kun la phan don du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bde gshegs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa la// bskal pa'i mthar mar bzhugs par ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// lus ngag yid gsum dge ba des// bgyis sam bgyid du stsal ba gang*// rjes su yid rang de dag ni// 'gro rnams kun gyis thob par shog

/spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i bdag /bla mar bcas pa thams cad la/ bdag ni rtag tu skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus 'di 'bul ba yis// theg pa dman la mi 'jug cing// theg mchog bla na med pa yi// lam cig bdag la bstan du gsol// gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// bsod nams ye shes byang chub lam// thabs dang shes rab go 'phang bgrod// de bzhin bdag gis lam bgrod do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// thams cad mkhyen par sangs rgyas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can don mdzad ltar// de bzhin bdag gis don bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*// dbugs ma dbyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'da' ba dang*// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces lan gsum brjod la sems bskyed par bya'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba dngos ni rig pa'i dbang lnga ste/ thog mar dbang bskur ba'i don du tshe las 'das pa dkyil 'khor du zhugs par bsam zhing*/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// rig pa'i dbang lnga yongs rdzogs ltar// de bzhin dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod la me tog kyang dbul lo/ de nas rnam rgyal bum pas dbang bskur bar byas ste/ ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras rnams la bskur ba ltar// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// bhud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/

ces pa dang*/ ci ltar ltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes pas khrus bya'o// de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rdo rje'i dbang ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje rigs kyi gtso// zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// me long lta bu'i dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra swa twa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas 'od dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin yi ge drug ma blangs la/ pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung mchog dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur bya// oṃ pad ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī/ de nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo bgrang 'phreng blangs la/ rin chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// nga rgyal rang sar dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ de nas don yon grub pa'i ngo bor mar me blangs la/ 'phrin las yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du// phrag dog rang sar dag pa yi// sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ zhes dbang bskur ro// dbang bskur nas tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa lha'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa bsdus pa tsam bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni gsum las/ dang po ni/ spros pa la dga' na zas gtad pa yang byas la/ de nas nub tha ma la ming byang bsregs pa ni/ ming byang lag tu thogs nas/ chos sku dri med rdo rje 'chang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro ba'i mgon// tshe 'das sems nyid mchod par 'bul// ma dag gzugs kyi phung po sgrol// mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bu yis// mi bskyod rdo rje rigs kyi gtso// tshe 'das rnam shes mchod par 'bul// zhes sdang dbyings su bsgral mdzad gsol// dri med pad ma lta bu yis// 'chi med rgyal po 'od dpag med/ tshe 'das 'du shes mchod par 'bul// 'dod chags dbyings su bsgral mdzad gsol// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi// yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/

tshe 'das tshor ba mchod par 'bul// nga rgyal dbyings su bsgral mdzad gsol// 'phrin las thams cad yongs rdzogs shing*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// tshe 'das 'du byed mchod par 'bul// phrag dog dbyings su sgrol mdzad gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs// rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// tshe 'das skye mched mchod par 'bul/ khams gsum skye mched dbyings su sgrol// rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa las/ tshogs gnyis zung 'jug 'phrin las kyis// bar dor gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams// thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur du drongs// zhes brjod la bsreg go /gnyis pa lam bstan pa ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgaum pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas rnam pa kun sbyangs te// 'phags pa'i lam der bgrod par shog /oṃ rad ne rad ne mahā rad ne sam̐ bha bā/ rad ne ki rad na ma le bha shud dhe/ sho dha yā sarba pa paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ srid pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i// srid pa'i pad ma las byung pa'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad me pad me pad mo sa bha sa bha bā su gar+ya ghad tsha tu swā hā/ zhes brjod do// me tog gtor zhing smon lam yang gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod ci rigs par bya ste/ bzod par gsol ba dang gshegs su gsol ba bkra shis la sogs mchod 'bul nas bshad pa ltar bya'o/ gsum pa bsngo ba ni/ de ltar tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba gang rung bya'o// de ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas/ cho ga bya zhing gzungs bton pa'i phan yon ni/ za ma tog bkod pa las byung ngo*// mdo dang rgyud las ji ltar byung ba dang*// sprul pa'i rgyal pos mdzad pa'i man ngag dang*// bla ma'i gsung las byung ba rgyas pa ru// spel ba'i tshig 'di rang byung rdo rjes sbyar/

oṃ ā hūm̐ hri: oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐ oṃ pad ma tshin dha ma ni dza la hūm̐ hrī dza/ bi pu ni gar rbe/ ma ni pra bhe/ ta thā ga ta ne di ri sha he: ma ṇi ma ṇi su pra bheḥ bhi ma leḥ sa ga ra ghaṃ bhi ra hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ dz+wa la dz+wa laḥ bhud dha bhi lo ki te/ ghu h+ya a h+yi shi tha de gar bhe swā hā/ pad ma dha ra/ a mo ka dha ra/ a mo gha dza ya teḥ tsu ru tsu ru swa hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di'am/ gzungs rings la sogs pa rgyun du brjod na/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'byang bar bshad do// rdzogs so/// /dge'o// legs so/// /
